lines.zh: 我后脚顶住叶面往前送
lines.en: I push off the leaf with my hind feet.
My feet grip the leaf edge.
I crawl along the leaf vein.

lines.zh: 身子一拱一伸，走得很慢。
lines.en: Arch, stretch, and on, slowly.
I pause in the middle of the leaf.
I don't dare go off the leaf.

lines.zh: 我绕过叶子上的一滴露。
lines.en: I go round a dewdrop.
My body is pale green.

lines.zh: 我用前脚试探下一片叶。
lines.en: I test the next leaf with a front foot.
The leaf edge is a bit dry.
I move to the tender end.
A thin line runs down my back.

lines.zh: 我把自己折起来又伸直。
lines.en: I fold myself up, then straighten.
I crawl to the underside, cooler there.
I chew my way forward.

lines.zh: 我停在叶脉交叉的地方。
lines.en: I stop where the veins cross.
I raise my front half to look.
All my feet hold tight.
I'm chewing the edge of a leaf.
The leaf has holes I made.
I lift my front half and look around.
The wind flips the leaf up and down.
I listen to what's around.
A bird calls overhead.
I move a little, slowly.
My body swells and slumps.
I press flat to the leaf.
I lower my head to eat.
Your hand is much bigger than a leaf.
I'm in the middle of the leaf.
Don't pinch me up.
I die if I leave the leaf.
Your shadow blinds me.
Just cradle me on your finger, don't pinch.
I have no spines.
I'm soft, and easy to pick up.
You're not going to eat me?
There's enough leaf until I pupate.
I curl up and can't move.
Green juice runs from me.
I bury my head in the leaf.
A segment sticks to the leaf.
Green juice seeps from the tear in me.
I'm soft; I don't take hits.
I've crumpled the leaf.
I slowly recover.
I'm still on the leaf. Good.
I just want to keep eating.
The tenderest part is the edge.
The leaf you set down is fresh.
I crawl that way.
This leaf tastes good.
I touch nothing but this leaf.

lines.zh: 我在叶缘上啃出第一道缺口
lines.en: I chew the first notch out of the leaf edge.
Bring the leaf closer.
I smell the leaf sap.
This one is enough.
I chew slowly.
You bumped the leaf.
My rear half hangs over the leaf edge.
I caught the edge and stopped.
I'm squeezed flat against the vein.
I curl my front half.
The leaf tips and I grip its rim.
I turned around.
I crawled back to the centre.
Your finger touched me.
I didn't fall.
Another one is on the leaf's underside.
Her colour is deeper than mine.

lines.zh: 她的头和我挤在一处叶脉
lines.en: Her head crowds mine at the same vein.
Our heads touch.
She's a bit smaller.

lines.zh: 我们一起往叶子中间挪。
lines.en: We both move toward the middle.
She eats slowly.
I go round the other end.

lines.zh: 叶子被我们啃出一块空地。
lines.en: Between us we clear a patch.
She goes under the leaf first.
I crawl over a grain of sand.
It lodges between my feet.
I shook it off.
Something small is on the leaf.
I touched it; it ran.
I'm dragging a scrap of leaf.

lines.zh: 我用头顶开挡路的碎石
lines.en: I headbutt the pebble out of my way.
Too heavy; I can't move it.

lines.zh: 我用肚子把那粒沙盖住
lines.en: I cover the grain of sand with my belly.
That isn't food.
Something moved at the leaf's edge.
I rear up and reach for the leaf edge.
I shift an inch that way.

lines.zh: 它投下的影子占了半片叶
lines.en: Its shadow covers half the leaf.
I have nowhere to run.
I press against the vein.
The leaf starts to shake.
It touched the leaf.
I curl into a green ring.
It didn't grab me.
It circles the leaf.
I retreat a little at a time.
All six feet dig into the leaf.
My scent is on the leaf.
It bent to look.
I don't move at all.
It walked away again.
The wind turns the leaf.
I'm still in the middle.
I don't even dare twitch my antennae.

lines.zh: 被压到的地方渗出了绿水。
lines.en: Green fluid seeps where I was pressed.
I tuck my head under the leaf vein.

lines.zh: 我从叶子边上滑了一下。
lines.en: I slipped near the leaf's edge.
I caught a vein.
Half my body hangs off.
I crawl back, slowly.
The leaf bent under the weight.
I cling to the leaf stalk and won't let go.
I curl up like a rolled leaf.
I'm still creeping along.
A small worm appears on the leaf.

lines.zh: 我先啃破了身边的卵壳
lines.en: I chew my way out of the egg case.
First, a bite of leaf.
The plains leaves are tender.
I found the vein.
I press myself to the leaf.
Sun on the leaf is warm.
I start my first bite.
There are other insects around.
I work my way to the middle.

lines.zh: 叶子先烫起来，我往下爬。
lines.en: The leaf heats first; I crawl down.

lines.zh: 我掉在地上，脚抓不到东西。
lines.en: I fall to the ground; my feet find nothing.

lines.zh: 一滴水把我整个包住了。
lines.en: A drop of water covers me completely.

lines.zh: 叶子被掀走，我也被掀了。
lines.en: The leaf is torn away, and me with it.

lines.zh: 那根刺从我背上透出来
lines.en: The spike comes out through my back.

lines.zh: 我的身体忽然不听使唤。
lines.en: My body suddenly won't obey.
I'm forgetting what leaf sap tastes like.

lines.zh: 雷光闪过，我的脚全松了。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and my feet all let go.
No leaf; I keep falling.
